task_description: Create comparative latency benchmark tests that demonstrate the before (sequential/unoptimized) vs after (parallel/pipelined/optimized) performance for chat endpoint and page load. Tests simulate both code paths with controlled delays and produce concrete timing comparisons.

verification.summary: All 16 benchmark tests pass (6 backend pytest + 5 edge vitest + 5 frontend vitest). Chat endpoint: OLD ~351ms vs NEW ~176ms (50% improvement). Page load: OLD ~246ms vs NEW ~15ms (94% improvement). Edge rate limit: OLD ~45ms vs NEW ~10ms (77% improvement). Frontend fetches: OLD ~241ms vs NEW ~100ms (58% improvement). All tests use controlled delays and are deterministic.
